_comment: Single source of truth for the desk light grammar. Consumed by bin/rgb-flash (colors + patterns), hue-stream/pc-rgb-effect.py (patterns), and bin/desk-event (caption colors via jq). color = category, pulse count = urgency. `scope` = name/room substrings the Hue flash is limited to (case-insensitive); omit scope so an event washes the whole room (reserve that for attention-getting events).
